case_name: SRL-2018 Remote Desktop Server RD-03 — Memory Forensics
description: Volatility3 memory analysis. 1 LOTL process + code injection in 7 processes. Lightest compromise among RD servers. Code injection present but minimal active C2 activity — possible earlier stage of infection or cleanup in progress.
devil_advocate: 1 LOTL process is within normal range for an admin-managed RD server. 7 injected processes could include false positives from legitimate JIT compilation.

artifacts.content: vol3 windows.pslist LOLBAS: 1 living-off-the-land process detected. Minimal active LOTL compared to other compromised RD servers (RD-01: 12, RD-04: 30). Single LOTL instance with 7 injected processes indicates dormant or low-cadence beacon.
forensic_anomalies: Single LOTL with 7 injected processes: payload deployed but C2 beacon in low-activity or sleep mode at acquisition time
Asymmetric ratio (1 LOTL : 7 injections) suggests attacker injected payload broadly then reduced active LOTL to minimize detection surface
Pattern consistent with staged compromise: initial injection phase (7 processes) followed by operational security reduction to 1 active beacon

artifacts.content: vol3 windows.malfind: code injection in 7 processes (PIDs: 8824, 4688, __, 00, 8120 and others). PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE regions. Memory acquisition 2018-09-07.
forensic_anomalies: Code injection in 7 processes with same +RWX memory signature as other corpus hosts — identical attacker toolkit confirms same campaign
7 injected processes without full LOTL activity: payload established persistence before reducing operational footprint
First active injection detected 2018-08-17 (from rsydow-a Documents folder timestamps on RD-02) — RD-03 infected approximately same period

artifacts.content: RD-03 in attack chain as propagation target with reduced operational presence. 5 of 6 RD servers compromised (RD-01, RD-03, RD-04, RD-05, RD-06 — only RD-02 memory clean). Systematic compromise of entire RD server farm confirms attacker goal was broad interactive access, not targeted exfiltration from specific host.
forensic_anomalies: 5/6 RD servers compromised — systematic sweep, not opportunistic. Attacker used RD-04 as hub to compromise all available RD servers
RD-03 low LOTL count (1) vs RD-04 (30) positions it as peripheral node — attacker allocated C2 resources proportionally to server value
Corpus correlation: all 5 compromised RD servers show identical injection signature, confirming single attacker operating from LARIAT C2 framework on RD-04

peirce_chain.firstness: RD server in compromised network — lateral movement target
peirce_chain.secondness: Code injection in 7 processes confirmed — deliberate compromise, not accidental
peirce_chain.thirdness: Minimal LOTL with moderate injection count suggests RD-03 was a propagation target rather than an operational C2 base. Attacker spread payload across all RD servers systematically.
